This executable report separates planning, fitting, and reporting saved results.
The checked-in HTML records the **analysis plan**, not new empirical findings.
The paper's application summary remains pending. Select `report` with a verified
completed output directory to render results; select `run` explicitly to fit.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE,message=FALSE,warning=TRUE)
here<-dirname(knitr::current_input(dir=TRUE))
source(file.path(here,"ocean.R"),local=TRUE)
data_dir<-params$data_dir
if(nzchar(data_dir)&&!grepl("^/",data_dir)) data_dir<-file.path(here,data_dir)
output_dir<-params$output_dir
if(!nzchar(output_dir)) {
  if(params$action!="plan")stop("Set output_dir for run/report.")
  output_dir<-file.path(tempdir(),"ocean-plan")
}
result<-ocean_analysis(data_dir,output_dir,params$action,params$profile,params$cores)
```

## Selected analysis

```{r settings, results='asis'}
if(params$action=="plan") {
  selected<-if(is.data.frame(result))result else result$tasks
  print(eivGP::report_table(selected))
} else {
  print(eivGP::report_table(result$prediction$summary))
  print(eivGP::report_table(result$prediction$availability))
}
```

```{r figures, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if(params$action!="plan" && length(result$prediction$plots))
  for(p in result$prediction$plots) print(p)
```

## Interpretation and provenance

The public frozen cohort and fold assignments are included under data/ocean_silicate. The analysis compares predictive performance and inference for incompletely observed oxygen inputs.

All reusable fitting, diagnostics, comparison, tables, and plotting functions
come from `eivGP`. Large output files remain outside Git. This report is generated
from the accompanying `.Rmd`, which calls the same `.R` workflow as batch runs.

```{r session, echo=FALSE}
packageVersion("eivGP")
sessionInfo()
```
